product_one_liner.value: DataGrail provides brands’ privacy, legal, and security teams a platform for data discovery and mapping, data-subject request management, consent management, and privacy-risk assessment.
product_one_liner.notes: The documentation describes DataGrail as a privacy platform for brands and identifies data discovery/mapping, DSR management, consent management, and privacy risk assessment for privacy, legal, and security teams. Source: https://docs.datagrail.io/

pricing_page.notes: The homepage navigation and footer list no pricing link, and the checked /pricing/ URL returned a 302 page rather than a public pricing page. Sources: https://www.datagrail.io/ and https://www.datagrail.io/pricing/

Sources: https://www.datagrail.io/customers/ncino and https://www.datagrail.io/customers/ | named_customers.0: The nCino case study identifies nCino as a DataGrail user. | named_customers.1: The DataGrail customer page names Okta.

employee_band.notes: The company profile lists 73 employees, which falls in the requested 51–100 band. Source: https://tracxn.com/a/d/company/5b078bc0e4b0ac69809457ae/datagrail#a:about

hq_location.notes: hq_city: The company press page states that DataGrail is headquartered in San Francisco, California. Source: https://www.datagrail.io/press/datagrail-recognized-as-a-leader-in-the-2025-idc-marketscape-for-worldwide-data-privacy-compliance-software | hq_country: The company press page places its headquarters in San Francisco, California, and the company profile identifies the country as the United States. Sources: https://www.datagrail.io/press/datagrail-recognized-as-a-leader-in-the-2025-idc-marketscape-for-worldwide-data-privacy-compliance-software and https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/DataGrail

founded_year.notes: DataGrail's press page says it was founded in May 2018, supporting 2018. Source: https://www.datagrail.io/press/datagrail-recognized-as-a-leader-in-the-2025-idc-marketscape-for-worldwide-data-privacy-compliance-software

eng_blog.notes: The Engineering-category API Design post discusses how DataGrail builds integrations with third-party APIs, including API design and testing. The Engineering-category security/privacy post includes a DataGrail Senior Software Engineer and discusses product-security and data practices; another Engineering post describes the company’s engineering practices. Together these support a technical engineering blog. Sources: https://www.datagrail.io/blog/company/engineering/api-design-series-part-1, https://www.datagrail.io/blog/company/engineering/prioritizing-data-security-privacy, and https://www.datagrail.io/blog/company/engineering/the-datagrail-engineering-way. The author-role and authorship evidence is not perfectly direct, so confidence is medium.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation site provides multiple product documentation sections, including Request Manager, Consent, Live Data Map, Risk Assessments, and Responsible Data Discovery. Source: https://docs.datagrail.io/

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Greenhouse board lists four openings: Senior Customer Success Manager, IT & Business Systems Manager, Senior Demand Generation Manager, and Senior Product Marketing Manager. None has an AI, ML, data-science, or other listed qualifying title. Source: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/datagrail

model_provider.value: Anthropic Claude (Claude Sonnet 5 and Claude Haiku 4.5), hosted via AWS Bedrock
model_provider.notes: DataGrail’s Vera security documentation names Claude Sonnet 5 and Claude Haiku 4.5 and says the models are hosted on AWS Bedrock. Source: https://docs.datagrail.io/docs/vera/privacy-and-security

compliance_certs.notes: compliance_certs: The company’s security page explicitly says it is HIPAA compliant and has SOC 2 Type II certifications. These are the listed certifications from the requested set. Source: https://www.datagrail.io/solutions/privacy-solution-for-security-teams | compliance_certs.0: The security page names HIPAA compliance. | compliance_certs.1: The same sentence names SOC 2 Type II certification.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The Enterprise Account Executive posting now says it is no longer open, and the current DataGrail board lists four other roles with no SDR, BDR, or AE title. Source: https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/datagrail

launched_6mo.notes: DataGrail’s June 23, 2026 announcement introduced its Data Broker Compliance product, a launch within the six months before November 9, 2026. Source: https://www.datagrail.io/blog/product/introducing-automated-drop-compliance-built-for-privacy-teams

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Christopher Wright’s profile identifies him as VP of GTM Ops, Growth & AI and dates his DataGrail role from 2026-06-01, within the 12-month window. Amy Reagan Hollo’s profile also lists her COO role ending 2026-04-01. Sources: https://linkedin.com/in/chrishwright and https://linkedin.com/in/amy-reagan-hollo
